csv_project_name: DB for Relay Ground Station South Rgs-S Antenna
csv_agency: USACE-US Army Corp of Engineers-Omaha District, NE
csv_scope_of_work: This project is a Design-Build contract to support the Space Development Agency (SDA) by constructing a Relay Ground Station-South (RGS-S) at Schriever Space Force Base. The purpose is to provide the necessary facilities and infrastructure to support the RGS-S mission within a restricted area. The scope of work requires the contractor to design, procure, install, and commission a complete and usable facility. The primary components of the project include: Concrete pads Antenna pedestal foundations and radome ringwalls Site utilities, pathways, and cabling Backup generators and fuel tanks Shelters
